title: The Hostage Peace
text: After a winter of knives in the dark, the magistrates have had enough. The House with the most Scions must send a Ward to a rival Seat, and take one back, as the old Houses did when the city was young. The magistrates call it a peace. Everyone else calls it hostages.

options.label: Name the House you will exchange Wards with.

outcomes.text: The Wards change Seats in a closed carriage at midnight. Each House has someone at the other's table now, and each table is a little more careful.

options.label: Bribe the magistrates to look elsewhere.

outcomes.text: The magistrates find another way to keep the peace. It involves gibbets.

options.label: Refuse. No child of this House sleeps under another roof.

outcomes.text: The magistrates write your refusal into the record. The other Houses read it aloud at dinner.
